subject: english
question:
Directions: Each of the following questions has underlined idioms/phrases. Each sentence is followed by four options. Choose the option that best describes the meaning of the underlined idiom/phrase.

Armed to the teeth

options.text: Decide to continue in spite of difficulties

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1'** i.e.** 'Carrying a lot of weapons'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom** "Armed to the teeth"** means to be heavily armed with weapons or to be excessively equipped with resources. 
 
• In English, it signifies** "carrying a lot of weapons**" (शस्त्रों से पूर्णतः सज्जित होना).
 
 
• **Example: **The bank robbers were armed to the teeth when they entered the bank.
 
 
 
• The term** "Carrying a lot of weapons"** is a literal translation of being armed heavily or being excessively equipped for attack or defense (ढेर सारे हथियार ले कर चलना).
 
 
• **Example: **The soldiers were carrying a lot of weapons during their mission to infiltrate enemy lines.
 
 

Therefore, the** correct answer** is - '**Carrying a lot of weapons'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Decide to continue in spite of difficulties' **(Option 2)** implies a situation where one chooses to proceed, even in the face of challenging conditions or adversity (कठिनाइयों के बावजूद जारी रखने का फैसला करना).
 
• 'Very frustrated'** (Option 3)** describes a state of dissatisfaction or annoyance resulting from unresolved problems or unfulfilled goals (बहुत ही निराश).
 
• 'Very difficult to do'** (Option 4) r**efers to a task that requires a great deal of effort or skill to accomplish (करना बहुत कठिन होता है).

40:Tb88,
The correct answer is** 'Option 4' **i.e. '**Resolve'.**
